reason: A DSH learning-mode plugin that turns selected or completed-session concepts into structured explanations, maintains a shared learning thread, and adapts explanations to recorded progress.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 工作会话中的概念整理为结构化讲解，维护跨会话学习线程，并根据学习进度提供后续解释。
summaries.en: Turns concepts from DSH work sessions into structured explanations, maintains a cross-session learning thread, and adapts future explanations to recorded progress.

capabilities: generates explanations through auxiliary model calls
stores learning history and settings locally
provides learning controls and cards in the user interface
